notes: v6.6.6 — AI Pages Enhancement Sprint (Muse/Melo/Suno). (1) Credit bypass: removed frontend/backend credit > 0 checks in MusePage.jsx, MeloPage.jsx, muse.controller.js so the full generation flow can be tested with 0 credits (API returns natural errors). (2) Lyrics validation: Melo controller minimum lowered from 50 to 10 characters so short test prompts can reach the API. (3) Console UTF-8: init.js forces stdout/stderr to UTF-8 on Windows before any Logger writes so Chinese lyrics and API error text render correctly instead of '????'. (4) Detailed generation logs: MusePage/MeloPage/SunoPage now log every step (params parsed, request body, HTTP status, response snippet, elapsed time) to console + on-screen log panel. (5) Visual bridge (CDP fill-input): museCdpBridge.js major rewrite — Strategy 4 handles uni-app's custom placeholder rendering (sibling DIV instead of placeholder attribute) by walking up the DOM from a matching placeholder leaf-element. Muse fill-input matches '灵感' textarea; Melo fill-input composes structured command (lyrics + style tags + title) into chat input. Both verified against live Edge tabs. (6) Generation history & copy: all three AI pages now store per-session history (timestamp, title, input preview, metadata, status) in localStorage with one-click copy buttons for lyrics/commands/results. (7) Muse credit formula: displayedCredit = memberInfo.credit + max(0, evaluationCreditPaid - evaluationCreditNoPaid) — matches Edge DOM display (previously strict memberInfo.credit showed 0 when real was 20). (8) Muse CDP/DIRECT fallback: all 10 endpoints (getUser, generate, queryTask, styles, configs, templates, explore, fill-input, status, credit) use CDP first then DIRECT .env MUSE_API_KEY. (9) Dynamic port launcher: scripts/start-dev.mjs selects random ports from 4200-4999 range, avoids 5500/5501/5502/5173/3000/8000/42XXX, writes allocation to .dev-ports.json for frontend-backend sync. (10) Suno/Melo status endpoints: new /api/suno/status and /api/melo/status return real credit values and canGenerate flag. (11) 14 new diagnostic scripts: muse-all-tabs-dump, muse-dom-credit-react-probe, muse-generate-jwt-fields, muse-generate-page-test, muse-intercept-refresh, muse-live-token, muse-real-credit-dump, muse-session-refresh, muse-test-body-auth, muse-token-intercept, muse-ui-credit-dump, suno-raw-probe, test-muse-live-session, diagnostic-full-status for live debugging.
